newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva most active.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Pliva most active.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday with blue chip drugs firm Pliva accounting for most of the trading.
* Four of fourteen active issues rose, four fell and six were flat.
* Volume up at 9,487 units, turnover unchanged at 4.9 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer chocolate maker Kras rose 20 kuna to 520 on volume of 403 shares.
* Biggest decliner insurer Croatia Osiguranje lost 100 kuna to 1,400 on volume of 25 shares.
* Most active Pliva inched up 8 kuna to 465 with 6,655 shares sold. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
